familyLabels.dais: Battle Tower pedestal — two-stone value split

dais.line: A single fantasy game object alone on a completely plain flat pure white empty background - nothing else in the picture. Hand-painted 2D game art, soft painterly texture, warm sunlight from the upper left, bright cheerful adventure-game mood. LOW TOP-DOWN VIEW like a classic Pokemon overworld object: the camera is above and tilted forward, so the flat top reads as a SHALLOW ellipse and the tall FRONT FACE below it is clearly visible - about as much front face as top. The object is a grand raised circular PLATFORM built to be STOOD ON, wide, never a pillar. THE OBJECT IS MADE OF TWO DIFFERENT STONES. The top slab is pale warm travertine, almost colourless, and its flat elliptical top surface is COMPLETELY BARE AND EMPTY - no statue, orb, crystal or ornament stands on it. Beneath it the tall drum is a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT, MUCH DARKER stone: near-black weathered basalt, deep charcoal. The join between the pale top slab and the dark drum is sharp and obvious. Three broad shallow steps come forward and down at the front, in the pale stone. All ornament sits on the rim, the step risers and the drum: a fine carved egg-and-dart moulding at the rim and slender fluted pilasters around the drum, with thin bands of dark aged bronze. No glow, no runes, no magic, no plants.
